text_block_list.text: Standing before the path of challenge that had been forged, we shared in the joy. Surely, from this point on, her smooth and boundless leap forward would begin—
That's what I had thought.
—A few days later.
That day, I had a scheduled meeting with Loves Only You and was waiting in the Trainer's Office, but—
choice_data_list: (Running late? That's unusual...)

text_block_list.text:
"Finding it unusual that she hadn't arrived by the scheduled time,
I stepped out into the hallway while calling Loves Only You—"

Just as the ringing starts on the phone at my ear,
I faintly hear a ringtone from further down the hallway.

"A chilling premonition runs down my spine,
and as if spurred on by it, I break into a run—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—
choice_data_list: Loves!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You

text_block_list.text:

Starting now—

text_block_list.text: —Ouch...!!
choice_data_list: Look out!

text_block_list.text:
I catch Loves Only You as she suddenly collapses.
Looking closely, beads of sweat cover her forehead,
and it is obvious that something is terribly wrong.
choice_data_list: Are you hurting somewhere...!?
Are you hurting somewhere...!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, my leg's a little—

We called an ambulance right away
and rushed Loves Only You to the hospital.
There, she underwent a thorough examinationâ

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Judging by the swelling and pain in her leg,
it's likely a bacterial infection... Phlegmon, I'd wager.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Are the symptoms, um... serious?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“While it's not fatal enough to immediately end
her racing career, it is by no means
something to take lightly.”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it was caught early, so the symptoms shouldn't worsen any further.
However, a full recovery will likely take time.
choice_data_list: ...Will we make it in time for the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot guarantee it. Considering the training
period needed after recovery, I cannot definitively say
she will return to her peak condition."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: So moving forward, it will likely be unavoidable to adjust our rotation based on her recovery status at any given time.
By the time we returned to the academy, Loves Only You's leg pain had subsided thanks to treatment, and the rain had stopped...
choice_data_list: I've already called a taxi, so just wait a bit.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

...At this point,
whether you can run in the Oka Sho or not
entirely depends on your recovery from here on.

Plunged suddenly into such an uncertain and unstable state,
I wonder if her mental state will truly hold up...

text_block_list.text: "—Don't make such a scary face, Trainer-kun."
choice_data_list: Huh?

Following her example, I have to look forward and think.
About what we should do from here on out—

our future goals.

text_block_list.text:
"I explain my thoughts step by step
to Loves Only You--"
"The Oaks is a 2400m turf middle-distance GⅠ race held in May at Tokyo Racecourse."

A 2,400m race of equal history and prestige to the Japan Derby, the festival of Umamusume.
Its glory shines brightest of all among the Tiara.
"And the Yushun Himba (Oaks) is held about a month after the Oka Sho."

Naturally, we can expect better recovery time than with the Oka Sho.
If we are to make one our primary objective, the Oaks is the more realistic option.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, if we adjust our schedule now with the
Oaks as our primary goal, it will be that much
easier to yield results.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if you asked me which tiara of the Triple Tiara
I want the most, I'd say the Oaks...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"The title of 'Queen of the Oaks', granted to those who conquer
the classic distance, embodying both speed and strength—
it's super lovely and so cool♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm totally in favor
of making the Oaks our big goal!

text_block_list.text:

Should we enter the Oka Sho as originally planned, or—
Or, looking ahead to taking on the Oaks, we could make the Wasurenagusa Sho our target race, as it's often used as a prep race.

She had thought it through carefully before placing her trust in me. That unwavering trust.
Then, in answer to that trust, I shall choose. The path Loves Only You must walk next is—

"From the moment we made the Oaks our primary goal, my desire to help Loves Only You claim the title of Queen of the Oaks had grown stronger."
